title: Women's Doubles Pair Change for World Junior Championships Selection Trials
indian_angle: This update directly impacts the composition of India's junior women's doubles contingent for the upcoming BWF World Junior Championships.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) announced a change in the women's doubles pair for the selection trials of the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026, indicating ongoing adjustments in team formation.

title: Indian Team Coaching Camp for Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships in Guwahati
indian_angle: This camp is crucial for the preparation and development of India's promising young talent ahead of a major continental junior championship.
summary: A national coaching camp for the Indian team participating in the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026 is underway at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, focusing on player development.

title: Player Eligibility and Qualified List for World Junior Championships Final Selection Trials
indian_angle: This announcement confirms which Indian junior players have met the criteria and will proceed to the final stage of selection for the prestigious World Junior Championships.
summary: The BAI released the list of players who have qualified for the final selection trials for the VICTOR BWF World Junior Championships 2026, set to be held in Cairo, Egypt, following initial eligibility checks.

title: Haryana U-19 Tournament Postponed, Bhubaneswar Event Declared World Junior Selection
indian_angle: This change in the domestic calendar directly impacts Indian junior players vying for a spot in the World Junior Championships team.
summary: The Haryana U-19 Ranking Tournament has been postponed, with the Bhubaneswar U-19 Ranking Tournament now designated as the sole selection event for the BWF World Junior Championships 2026.

title: 3x15 Scoring System Implemented in Domestic Junior Tournaments and Nationals
indian_angle: This significant rule change for U-13, U-15, and U-17 categories will alter competitive dynamics for young Indian badminton players in national events.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) has implemented a new 3x15 scoring system for domestic ranking tournaments and national championships across the U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.
